record.question: The Mizo name given to the month of April is:
record.explanation: Answer D: Tau thla. The Mizo calendar names April Ṭau thla (Tau thla); this is option (d). Pawltlak thla is a different month name. Reference: https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/IndFarm/article/download/96914/38594/249941; https://mizostudiesmzu.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Mizo-Studies-Vol.XII-No.3-July-September-2023.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
